summary: In src/sensei_top/logs.py: added class _Level(logging.Filter), which passes records at or above its floor, and below it only INFO+ records named exactly sensei_top.llm or starting with sensei_top.llm. (sensei_top.llmx excluded). In install(): the console handler now setLevel(INFO) with addFilter(_Level(WARNING if verbose else ERROR)); the file handler setLevel(DEBUG if verbose else INFO), and when not verbose adds _Level(WARNING) after file_handler.handle(_header(...)) so the INFO header from logger 'sensei_top' is still written. Updated the docstring's Levels bullet to note both handlers take sensei_top.llm's INFO lines. root.setLevel(min(...)) unchanged. Checks: uv run pytest -q tests/test_logs.py = 32 passed; uv run ruff check . = All checks passed.
concerns: The filter is added to the file handler after the header only in the non-verbose branch, matching the task; verify no other INFO records from non-llm loggers are expected in the file by default.
